rules.source_preservation: Original Markdown master libraries remain authoritative and unchanged.
rules.shared_selection: Shared inventory items are pulled only when supported by plans, specifications, intake, contract, municipality, AHJ, project conditions or user direction.
rules.project_copy: Project packages reference master item IDs; project dates, durations, owners, status and evidence are stored separately.
rules.calendar_records: Holiday table records remain calendar data and are not converted into generic construction activities.
rules.traceability: Every selected shared item retains its department, group path, source file and source line.
